WITH sku_stats AS (
  SELECT
    pl.sku,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pl.period='2026-08' THEN pl.qty END) AS qty_aug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pl.period='2026-08' THEN pl.amount_cad END) AS amt_aug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pl.period='2026-09' THEN pl.qty END) AS qty_sep,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pl.period='2026-09' THEN pl.amount_cad END) AS amt_sep
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
  WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY pl.sku
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty END) AS total_qty_aug,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty END) AS total_qty_sep
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
),
sku_share AS (
  SELECT
    s.sku,
    s.qty_aug,
    s.qty_sep,
    s.qty_aug * 1.0 / t.total_qty_aug AS share_aug,
    s.qty_sep * 1.0 / t.total_qty_sep AS share_sep,
    (s.amt_aug / NULLIF(s.qty_aug,0)) AS avg_cost_aug,
    (s.amt_sep / NULLIF(s.qty_sep,0)) AS avg_cost_sep
  FROM sku_stats s
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE s.qty_aug > 0 AND s.qty_sep > 0
)
SELECT
  sku,
  qty_aug,
  qty_sep,
  share_aug,
  share_sep,
  share_sep - share_aug AS share_change,
  avg_cost_aug,
  avg_cost_sep,
  avg_cost_sep - avg_cost_aug AS cost_change
FROM sku_share
ORDER BY cost_change DESC
LIMIT 20
